name: ActivityFeed
description:
An activity or notification feed using shared relative times and accessible absolute tooltips.

As a timeline, such as a version history, items take a `tone` for the marker and `children`
for one level of branches. Selection makes it a listbox with one tab stop (R11.5):
↑ ↓ Home End move, and a click, Enter or Space selects. Selection does not follow focus,
so moving through a long history loads nothing. A plain feed stays an ordinary list.
signature: ({ items, empty: emptyProp, className, selectedId, defaultSelectedId, onSelectedIdChange, ...rest }: ActivityFeedProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: The event selected at first when uncontrolled.

props.name: empty
props.description: One factual line when there are no events.

props.name: items
props.description: Events in the application's chosen order.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.description: Called with the id of the event the person selects by click, Enter or Space, and details.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The selected event's id, controlled; null selects none. Supplying this, `defaultSelectedId` or `onSelectedIdChange` makes the feed selectable.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
